answer: A sybil farm seeds many identities at once, so make that burst costly. Every new identity pays a non-refundable deposit returned only after a proven track record, not upfront claims. Tie each identity to one human-scale capability, like a falcon's ownership of one nest: one control, one vote. Cross-check history: identities copying the same playbook or minting from one cluster share a lotus marker and count as one entity. Reward honest history with a nectar of earned standing, not bought status. Cloning cheap identities no longer scales; farm cost rises per identity.
